name: Load chat widget loader script
description: Call this when you need the browser-side bootstrap script that injects and styles the Brevo Conversations chat widget on a page — for example to verify that the widget loader is being served for the account, or to inspect the CSS and DOM setup the widget applies. The response is JavaScript for a browser to execute, not structured data, so do not use it to read conversation or chat data. To turn the Conversations product on for the account, use the enable-conversations-app action instead; to read account-level Conversations configuration, use the account info actions.
preconditions: The request must be made against the Conversations app host (conversations-app.brevo.com).
The Conversations app must be reachable for the account for the loader to be served.

body.description: A JavaScript program (served as text, not JSON) that creates a style element with brevo-conversations CSS rules and appends it to document.head, bootstrapping the chat widget in the page.

side_effects: When the returned script is executed in a browser, a style element is appended to document.head and the chat widget is bootstrapped in the page. Fetching the script alone changes nothing server-side.
